Thanks for the ping. Quick summary from infra logs: Ariba posts a RelayState param that includes the tenant hint. Our gateway is normalizing query params and, in this case, a rewrite rule dropped the RelayState payload when a third-party redirect token is present — that leads Ariba's validation to fail with the exact message Maya pasted.

Temporary workaround (we can do this now):
1) I generated a one-time activation URL that will bypass the external RelayState redirect and directly activate the Harborline supplier record. Token expires in 48 hours.
2) Please try this link and confirm: https://redwood.ai/supplier-activate/one-time?token=ACT-9f3a2b

Longer-term fix:
- Remove the aggressive query-param normalization on the ariba gateway for the /accept endpoint and add a unit test for RelayState passthrough (estimated 4–6 hours of dev + 2 hours of QA). I've opened INF-2345 to track the change.

I attached the activation token to an internal text file for audit: activation-link.txt

Maya — Sean and I are both on this. Please click the link above and let us know whether it completes the acceptance flow. If you hit anything else, reply here and we'll escalate.
